R/ [SALVS DD NN AVG ET CAES]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Magnentius or Decentius (350-353), Chi Rho reverse issue of 352-353, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust draped right. Reverse description: Chi Rho, alpha and omega in field. Reverse inscription: [SALVS DD NN AVG ET CAES]. Diameter: 24.0mm, Weight: 5.09gms, die axis: 6
